scope: Source delivery including historical archives; active runtime entry remains state3/FM, not historical state1/state2/VM paths.

tracked_exceptions.SINGLEHOST-SHA256SUMS: Digest manifest cannot hash itself; the external archive checksum covers its bytes.

trust_boundary: Checksums establish inventory/byte consistency, not publisher authenticity. No external signing root is established. Git coverage is checked only when the repository itself is a Git checkout; archive verification reports that dimension NOT_RUN.
